children.innerHTML: Six people, one room, no account managers.
What it is like to work with us, told plainly.

Aker began as two people and a borrowed desk. Six years on there are six of us: designers, a writer and a builder of things. We stay small on purpose; small means the person you hired is the person who shows up.
Six projects a year. That's the whole capacity plan.
Rough work on Tuesdays beats polish in month three.
Decisions get a sentence. Future-you says thanks.
Every handover includes the why, not just the files.
Or come by. The coffee is decent and the chairs are our client's.
